description.text: In a cramped garage, the older mechanic leans over a partially stripped engine and points at a glazed drive belt while speaking to the younger mechanic. The younger mechanic straightens up from the fender with a wrench still in one hand. Around them, workbenches crowd the walls, tools hang from pegboard, and oil stains darken the concrete floor under a low, warm work light.
A cramped garage is crowded with workbenches, pegboard tools, and a partially stripped engine between two mechanics.
The older mechanic leans over the engine and points at a glazed drive belt while speaking to the younger mechanic.
The younger mechanic straightens up from the fender, the wrench still gripped in one hand.
Garage room tone mixes with tools clinking softly and the engine ticking as it cools.
The camera pushes in with small amplitude at slow speed.

The younger mechanic holds the older man's gaze, wipes grease from his fingers with a rag, and answers with a defiant lift of his chin. His shoulder squares against the fender, and the wrench taps once against his thigh. The older mechanic stays leaning over the engine, listening without softening his expression.
The younger mechanic faces the older mechanic across the engine, a rag in one hand and a wrench in the other.
The younger mechanic wipes grease from his fingers with the rag and answers with a lifted chin.
A rag rasps over skin beneath the low garage room tone and a distant tool clatter.
The older mechanic remains leaning over the engine, holding the younger man's gaze.
The camera holds a static shot.

Both men turn toward the engine. The older mechanic taps the slack drive belt with one fingertip, and the rubber shudders under the touch. The younger mechanic folds his arms and stares at the same part. The partially stripped engine sits between them, its glazed belt hanging in a strained loop while the garage holds its breath.
Both mechanics turn toward the partially stripped engine and the glazed drive belt at its center.
The older mechanic taps the slack drive belt with a fingertip, and the rubber shudders under the touch.
The younger mechanic folds his arms and stares at the same belt.
A fingertip taps rubber, the belt creaks, and the engine ticks beneath the garage room tone.
The camera pushes in with small amplitude at slow speed.
